summary: Candidate is a distinct Mistral-specific agent tracking session skill with concrete workflow steps, constraints, and AgentOps integration guidance. It differs semantically from peer candidates (CamelAI tracking, generic AgentOps setup, decorator instrumentation) and existing skills (Java/Spring migration, Maven repositories). No existing skill covers Mistral + AgentOps integration. Peer candidates are framework-specific alternatives, not overlaps. Support evidence confirms Mistral SDK >=0.32.0 + AgentOps integration is documented and valid.
